questions.text: What is an emergency fund for?
questions.explanation: An emergency fund covers unexpected expenses, such as an urgent repair.

questions.text: What usually happens if you pay only your credit card's minimum each month?

options.text: Repayment takes longer and costs more interest

questions.explanation: Paying only the minimum usually takes longer and costs more interest than paying more.

questions.text: How does compound interest help savings grow over time?

options.text: You earn interest on your savings and earlier interest
You earn interest only on the money you first saved
Your savings grow by the same fixed amount forever

questions.explanation: Compound interest earns interest on your savings and the interest already added.

questions.text: What does a budget help you do?

options.text: Plan how to use your income for spending and saving
Guarantee that your income will increase

questions.explanation: A budget helps you plan spending and saving based on your income.
